svg.text: Mounts UI / Opens Model Dropdown / Force Refresh
Return cached model list (instant UI render)
Phase 1: preValidation [requireAuth] strictly validates JWT HMAC token (Rejects 401 if missing/invalid)
Phase 2: preValidation [readApiLimitHook] (Tier 5: 120 req/min multi-tenant O(1) rate limit)
Phase 3: Fastify JSON Schema Validation (querystring additionalProperties: false, rejects 400)
Phase 4: IDOR ownership check on sessionId (firestoreBackendService.getSession)
HTTP 403 Forbidden { error: "Access denied: You do not own this session" }
Return { codex: { linked: boolean, email: string } }
Return [] (Skip VM execution to prevent leakage/waste)
executeInSandbox({ command: "sudo -u agent-runner -H env HOME=... bash -c 'test -s /home/agent-runner/.codex/auth.json && codex debug models'" })
Dispatches command over E2B encrypted control channel
codex debug models connects to OpenAI API with active token
Returns live model catalog JSON (~177 KB account models)
Register model slug in codexModelIds Set
Cache in sandboxModelsCache (TTL: 5s if linked but 0 models, else 300s)
Populate model dropdown (e.g. gpt-6-luna, gpt-5.6-terra, gemini-3.8-flash)
